scientific_question: Does the complete pre-2025 listed-life population of BTC DVOL futures contain enough ordinary public trade observations, independent contract episodes and active trading days to justify a separately governed Discovery MVE?
relationship_to_prior_gate: Materially different source-feasibility question. DVOL-TS-SOURCE-001 is closed as fixed-window data-insufficient and is not rescued or modified here.

official_product_assumptions_used_for_so.listed_population_model: one monthly contract; exact archived metadata is scientific authority for whether a generated candidate actually existed

candidate_instrument_discovery.method: Generate every UTC Wednesday date from 2023-03-29 through 2024-12-25 inclusive; format BTCDVOL_USDC-DDMMMYY; query exact archived get_instrument for each candidate. This calendar enumeration is fixed before acquisition and does not use observed trades to choose dates.

lifecycle_trade_acquisition.bounds: exact accepted instrument creation_timestamp through expiration_timestamp, clipped only to 2023-03-27T00:00:00Z through 2024-12-31T23:59:59.999Z
lifecycle_trade_acquisition.slice_rule: deterministic 24-hour UTC slices; count=1000 sorting=asc; recursively bisect exactly-1000 slices until each leaf is below 1000 or <=1 second, otherwise technical failure
lifecycle_trade_acquisition.ordinary_public_trade_rule: Exclude records carrying a non-null block_trade_id or combo_id from liquidity counts. No direction, price, index level, mark level or amount distribution is summarized.

retained_source_metrics_only: ordinary public trade count per contract
unique UTC active-trading-day count per contract
first and last ordinary trade timestamps per contract
request byte counts and SHA-256 receipts
threshold_rationale_frozen: The gate requires roughly one year of independent monthly-contract clusters (>=12), a majority subset with repeat ordinary trading across >=5 distinct days (>=8 contracts), >=80 aggregate contract-days, and broad regime coverage across >=6 calendar quarters. These are source adequacy requirements only and do not encode a desired economic result.
stop_rule: If any frozen source-viability gate fails, stop with LIFECYCLE_SOURCE_DATA_INSUFFICIENT. Do not lower thresholds, replace contracts, choose denser subperiods, widen into 2025/2026, or open economic outcomes under this gate ID.
post_pass_rule: Even on LIFECYCLE_SOURCE_DATA_PASS, STOP. A separate pre-Discovery authority must freeze any economic signal, timing, settlement/index source, costs and statistical gates before basis or convergence values are opened.
